title: Tour: Opportunities
blurb: Your sales board: every quote and deal, stage by stage.

steps.title: Open Opportunities
steps.body: Click **Opportunities** in the left menu. This is where you track quotes and deals.

steps.title: Pick a pipeline
steps.body: Use the pipeline dropdown at the top to switch between pipelines, for example Sales and Repeat Work.

steps.title: The board
steps.body: Each column is a stage, like New Lead, Quote Sent or Booked. Each card is one deal, showing the customer and value. The column header shows the total value in that stage.

steps.title: Board or list
steps.body: Switch between the card board and a list view. The list view can show all pipelines at once and is easier to sort and filter.

steps.title: Add a deal
steps.body: Click **Add Opportunity** to add a new deal.

steps.title: What next
steps.body: No pipeline yet? Start with **Create a pipeline** from the Guide. Otherwise try **Add an opportunity**.
